title: Add ImageGenerator.MAUI to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [ImageGenerator.MAUI](https://github.com/MR-444/ImageGenerator.MAUI) to image
- ImageGenerator.MAUI is an open-source (MIT) Windows desktop image-generation app built with .NET MAUI. Users pick a model, enter a prompt, and generate images; every saved image embeds the full prompt

Fixes #11432

gist.headline: A MAUI flower blooms
gist.blurb: ImageGenerator.MAUI joined the image garden: a Windows desktop app for picking a model, writing a prompt, and keeping the full prompt tucked inside every saved image.
gist.summary: Added ImageGenerator.MAUI, an MIT-licensed .NET MAUI Windows desktop image-generation app where users select a model, enter a prompt, and save images with their full prompts embedded.
gist.impact: Windows creators now have another open-source desktop route into Pollinations image generation, with prompt metadata preserved inside each saved result.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy Windows desktop-style retro workstation in a flower-filled garden shed, with Polli wearing tiny developer headphones beside a CRT monitor showing an image generator UI with a model selector and prompt box. A freshly generated pixel landscape is being saved into a glowing picture frame, with a small prompt-scroll tucked into the frame to symbolize embedded prompt metadata; code-plants and lime-green blossoms reinforce the open-source app garden.
